purpose: Teach: 駆ら/向かわ/住環境/引き取っ/鉄筋コンクリート/取り外し/同乗/拝聴

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、義憤に駆られた市民の通報も慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: Even reports from citizens driven by righteous indignation get handled with care, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful opening, weighing the words. Even polite pace, gentle emphasis on the carefulness, rising tag.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者を取調べに向かわせる手続きを、警察、徹底されますね
lines.en: The procedure for sending a suspect in for questioning is followed to the letter.
lines.style: Steady and procedural, respect creeping in. Slight stress on the thoroughness, confirming lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の住環境調査も慎重にされますね
lines.en: They look into the victim's living environment carefully, too.
lines.style: Softer, considerate tone for the victim mention. Slower pace, careful gentle landing on the final particle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、保護した子供を施設に引き取って頂くケースもされますね
lines.en: There are even cases where they arrange for a facility to take in a child under protection.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly moved delivery. Quiet pace, warmth gathering around the child, trailing respectful finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場の鉄筋コンクリート構造を、警察、分析されますね
lines.en: They even analyze the reinforced concrete structure of a crime scene.
lines.style: Perked-up curiosity on the technical detail. Brisker pace, small impressed stress landing on the analysis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不審物の取り外しを、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: And removing a suspicious object is carried out with the utmost care.
lines.style: Hushed, almost cautious delivery mirroring the content. Slow deliberate pace, breath held through the middle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査車両の同乗者ルールも厳密にされますね
lines.en: The rules on who rides along in an investigation vehicle are kept strict as well.
lines.style: Back to brisk professional admiration. Clean articulation, a firm nod of approval closing the line.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、専門家の意見を拝聴する機会も設けられますね
lines.en: And they set aside occasions to humbly hear out the experts, don't they.
lines.style: Warm concluding tone, softening with respect. Unhurried pace, appreciative downward settle at the very end.
